name: generic
description: Single video, keep the source format unless asked. Conservative defaults.

automix_presets._comment: ADR-134: the agent's production values for audio-production AUTOMIX (the Skill has no default for window_ms / max_gain_rate_db_per_s) and the floor level under an interpreter (MIX_TRACKS). Used only when audio.automix is asked for; recorded in the plan as PROFILE requirements; an explicit --set wins.

panel.description: panel discussion, one microphone per panellist: a share follows the talker within about a syllable, the last open microphone holds through a pause

interview.description: two or three close microphones with quick exchanges: faster measurement and gain changes
